name: PAD OWNER
description: One controller per window, which is the only thing standing between you and split screen. Run the game twice side by side and you already have two worlds on one monitor -- but SDL broadcasts every pad's events to every process, and the engine's input layer discards which pad an event came from, so both windows answer to both controllers. POKEPORT_PAD=2 makes this copy answer to the second pad and ignore the rest. Nothing about the game itself changes: each player is playing an ordinary single-player save that happens to be sharing your desk. Inert unless POKEPORT_PAD is set, so it is safe to leave installed when playing alone.
